skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.reason: First step of the workflow: interviews you about a plan and records terms and decisions as it goes.

skills.name: grilling
skills.reason: The interview loop that grill-with-docs calls.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.reason: Keeps GLOSSARY.md and the ADRs up to date; grill-with-docs calls it.

skills.name: to-spec
skills.reason: Turns the interview into an OpenSpec change through the adapter.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.reason: Breaks a change into vertical-slice tickets in tasks.md.

skills.name: implement
skills.reason: Builds one ticket per session with tdd and finishes with code-review.

skills.name: tdd
skills.reason: Test-first loop at agreed seams; implement calls it.

skills.name: code-review
skills.reason: Reviews each ticket against the coding standards and the spec; implement calls it.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.reason: Shared vocabulary for module interfaces and seams that tdd relies on.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.reason: Disciplined loop for hard bugs, the gap left by excluding Addy's debugging skill.

skills.name: prototype
skills.reason: Throwaway prototypes that answer a design question before it reaches the spec.

skills.name: research
skills.reason: Background research against primary sources, saved as a Markdown file.

skills.name: pr
skills.reason: Shapes pull request bodies; useful once a change is closed.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.reason: Finds refactoring opportunities in an existing codebase.

skills.name: handoff
skills.reason: Compacts a long session into a document a fresh session can pick up.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.reason: Guidance for editing skills, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.

skills.name: retro
skills.reason: Suggests improvements to the agent's environment after a session.

skills.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
skills.reason: The kit writes its configuration; running it would replace the OpenSpec adapter.

skills.name: triage
skills.reason: Moves issues through triage labels, which OpenSpec does not have.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.reason: Needs a map of tickets on a real issue tracker, which the adapter does not provide.

skills.name: implement-spec
skills.reason: Builds a whole spec with parallel agents on an integration branch, against one ticket per session.

skills.name: ask-matt
skills.reason: Routes to flows the kit replaces, such as triage and wayfinder.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.reason: Same interview as grilling, without the docs grill-with-docs keeps.

skills.name: git-guardrails-claude-code
skills.reason: A bash hook that the kit's cross-platform git-guard hook replaces.

skills.name: setup-pre-commit
skills.reason: Husky pre-commit setup for JavaScript only; the kit's quality gate covers any stack.

skills.name: teach
skills.reason: Outside the development workflow; install it by hand if you want it.

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.reason: Outside the development workflow; install it by hand if you want it.

skills.name: wait-what
skills.reason: Outside the development workflow; install it by hand if you want it.

skills.name: wizard
skills.reason: Generates bash scripts, which do not run in a plain Windows PowerShell setup.

skills.name: code-simplification
skills.reason: close-change uses it to simplify the whole change before archiving.
skills.when: simplifying working code without changing its behaviour

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.reason: close-change uses it to audit the whole change before archiving.
skills.when: handling untrusted input, authentication, secrets, personal data or new dependencies

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.reason: Performance work, which no workflow skill covers.
skills.when: a performance requirement exists or a slowdown is suspected

skills.name: frontend-ui-engineering
skills.reason: Accessible, responsive UI work, which no workflow skill covers.

skills.name: api-and-interface-design
skills.reason: Public API and contract design, beyond codebase-design's module vocabulary.
skills.when: designing a REST or GraphQL endpoint or a contract other code depends on

skills.name: browser-testing-with-devtools
skills.reason: Checks behaviour in a real browser; needs the Chrome DevTools MCP server.
skills.when: verifying something that runs in a browser

skills.name: observability-and-instrumentation
skills.reason: Logging, metrics and tracing, which no workflow skill covers.
skills.when: adding logs, metrics, traces or alerts

skills.name: ci-cd-and-automation
skills.reason: CI/CD pipelines, which no workflow skill covers.
skills.when: setting up or changing build and deployment pipelines

skills.name: shipping-and-launch
skills.reason: Pre-launch checklists and rollout plans, which no workflow skill covers.

skills.name: deprecation-and-migration
skills.reason: Removing systems and migrating users or data safely.
skills.when: removing an old system, API or feature, or migrating data in production

skills.name: source-driven-development
skills.reason: Checks framework usage against official documentation.
skills.when: using a framework or library where current, official usage matters

skills.name: interview-me
skills.reason: Overlaps grill-with-docs.

skills.name: idea-refine
skills.reason: Overlaps grill-with-docs and ships a bash script.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.reason: Overlaps to-spec and OpenSpec.

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown
skills.reason: Overlaps to-tickets.

skills.name: incremental-implementation
skills.reason: Overlaps implement.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.reason: Overlaps tdd.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.reason: Overlaps diagnosing-bugs.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.reason: Overlaps code-review.

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.reason: Overlaps domain-modeling, which keeps the ADRs.

skills.name: git-workflow-and-versioning
skills.reason: Its git rules compete with the kit's branch rules and git-guard hook.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.reason: Rewrites AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which the kit's templates own.

skills.name: using-agent-skills
skills.reason: Meta-skill that routes work into Addy's own workflow.

skills.name: constraint-driven-development
skills.reason: Sets up its own quality gate and relies on Addy's /build, /review and /ship commands.

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.reason: Triggers on every non-trivial decision and overlaps grilling and code-review.
